definition-changed.answer: Same referent: §2002:4 (4.167) 'The executable unit resulting from compiling a source element' and §2023:3.159 'element consisting of code and data produced by the compilation of a source element' name the same programs, functions and methods; 'the runtime element containing the CANCEL statement' is the same program. The scope and the evidence are unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: What follows the raise rests on §2002:14.5.12.1.2. For a CANCEL it is the same as 2023: a declarative then abnormal termination, unless RESUME continues (§2002:14.8.31.3 GR2: control goes to 'an implicit CONTINUE statement that immediately follows the end of the statement'); then PROPAGATE; then abnormal termination; implementor-defined when checking is off. 2023 adds only SORT/MERGE, EC-I-O and PERFORM WHEN steps, none of which reaches a CANCEL. EC-PROGRAM-CANCEL-ACTIVE is Fatal, so 14.5.12.1.3 does not apply, and 14.5.12.2 is EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE only.
